mapper.select: SELECT i.id,i.material_id,m.material_code,m.material_name,m.specification,i.location_id,z.zone_name,l.location_code,l.location_name,i.unit_id,u.unit_name,u.precision_scale,i.book_quantity,i.actual_quantity,i.difference_quantity,i.remark FROM wm_stocktake_order_item i LEFT JOIN wm_material m ON m.id=i.material_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse_location l ON l.id=i.location_id LEFT JOIN wm_warehouse_zone z ON z.id=l.zone_id LEFT JOIN wm_unit u ON u.id=i.unit_id WHERE i.stocktake_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY i.id
